questions.title: Median age of the population in Italy
questions.hint: Half the population is older than the median. It moves slowly and depends mostly on past births.
questions.explanation: It rose to 46 years in 2020, from 28 years in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Share of children who die before age five in Nigeria
questions.hint: Vaccines, clean water, and treatment for diarrheal disease all reach children first.
questions.explanation: It fell to 11.4% in 2020, from 34.1% in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in Japan
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It fell to -0.4% in 2020, from 1.7% in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Average number of children per woman in South Korea
questions.hint: Fertility tends to respond to education, urban living, contraception, and the cost of raising children.
questions.explanation: It fell to 0.8 in 2022, from 2.7 in 1980. South Korea’s fertility rate is now among the lowest in the world.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Marriages per 1,000 people in the United States
questions.hint: Marriage rates reflect social norms, but also the size of the age group most likely to marry.
questions.explanation: It went from 10.0 in 1915 to a high of 12.1 in 1940, then ended at 10.1 in 1985.

source.attribution: US Census Bureau; US CDC, National Center for Health Statistics
